from cyclopts import App, Parameter
from cyclopts.config import Toml

def main(
    name: str = Parameter(
        default="World",
        help="Name to greet"
    ),
    greeting: str = Parameter(
        default="Hello",
        help="Greeting prefix"
    ),
    verbose: bool = Parameter(
        default=False,
        help="Enable verbose output"
    ),
):
    """Simple CLI with TOML config support."""
    message = f"{greeting}, {name}!"
    print(message)
    if verbose:
        print("Verbose mode enabled")

app = App(
    config=Toml(
        "pyproject.toml",
        root_keys=["tool.mycli"],
        search_parents=True,
    ),
)
app.default_command = main

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
